title: Driver Vehicle Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Driver Vehicle Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Driver Vehicle Inspection Checklist covers power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status. The fleet dispatch coordinator records Driver Vehicle Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Driver Vehicle Inspection Checklist keeps Driver Vehicle Inspection exceptions visible until the fleet dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Driver Vehicle Inspection Checklist at yard, roadside safe area, vehicle cab, exterior walkaround, and trailer. Document power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status identity before Driver Vehicle Inspection begins. Compare power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status findings with stated Driver Vehicle Inspection criteria; route unresolved Driver Vehicle Inspection issues to qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer. For Driver Vehicle Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Driver Vehicle Inspection. Ask qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer to review Driver Vehicle Inspection conditions beyond the fleet dispatch coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Driver Vehicle Inspection, identify responsible parties, yard, roadside safe area, vehicle cab, exterior walkaround, and trailer, and the linked power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status source.

fields.label: Vehicle, unit, plate, odometer, and trailer
Prior defect, repair, and release references

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Driver Vehicle Inspection facts for power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Driver Vehicle Inspection checks
items: Tires, wheels, fasteners, and visible inflation
Lights, reflectors, mirrors, glazing, and wipers
Brakes, steering, suspension, coupling, and visible leaks
Horn, warning devices, emergency equipment, and restraints
Load securement, doors, landing gear, and trailer condition
Defect classification, restriction, repair, and release

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Driver Vehicle Inspection finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Fleet Dispatch Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Driver Vehicle Inspection when a safety-critical defect, inspection limitation, repair verification, or qualified release remains unresolved. Retain the available Driver Vehicle Inspection proof and route unresolved power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status scope to fleet dispatch coordinator.
